Companies Report Cyber Incidents, Data Access

Several companies have reported experiencing cyber incidents. Suzlon Energy stated it was affected by a cyber incident but that critical business applications remained unaffected. L&T Technology Services also reported its systems were secure amid reports of a cyber incident. Separately, the Spanish football league LaLiga confirmed data was extracted in a cyber attack, and the UK retailer Next said some data was accessed in a cyber incident affecting its online supplier.
